summary: On first run the Edge Manager agent generates a key pair as the device identity (private key never leaves the device), discovers the service, connects over mTLS with its X.509 enrollment certificate and submits an enrollment request with hardware/OS info and a CSR; the device waits quarantined in the device lobby until a user approves or denies it.
questions: How does Edge Manager device enrollment work?
What is the device lobby in Edge Manager?
Why is my edge device not trusted yet?
What does the agent send in an enrollment request?
